description: Tell the agent which Florque project this folder is bound to (or ask the user to pick one).

hooks.command: if command -v fwg >/dev/null 2>&1; then fwg session-context; else echo '## Florque Workgraph'; echo 'The fwg CLI is not installed. If the user wants the workgraph, ask them to install it: uv tool install florque-cli (see the invite email).'; fi
